title: GitStore ProductVariant
description: YAML frontmatter for a GitStore ProductVariant resource. A ProductVariant resource is a Markdown file: this schema validates only the frontmatter object between the opening and closing '---' delimiters. The remaining Markdown content is the free-form variant description body and is not covered by this schema. Represents a purchasable configuration of a parent Product with its own SKU, pricing, inventory policy, and optional media. See docs/products/product-variant-spec.md for the full authoring contract.

ObjectMeta.description: Author-writable resource metadata. Do not set uid, resourceVersion, generation, creationTimestamp, revision, ownerReferences, or finalizers — those fields are system-managed and any of them present in an authored file causes the push to be rejected.

name.description: DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, 1-63 characters, no leading/trailing hyphen. Identifies this ProductVariant uniquely within its namespace.

namespace.description: Optional. When omitted, the namespace is inferred from the owning repository at push time. When present, it is validated to match the inferred namespace.

labels.description: Optional key/value labels. Keys may use an optional "prefix/name" form; prefix ≤ 253 chars, name segment ≤ 63 chars. Values ≤ 63 chars.

annotations.description: Optional key/value annotations. No length restriction.

ObjectReference.description: A pointer to another catalogue resource.

name.description: Required. Name of the referenced resource.

FileReference.description: Identifies a File resource by name and kind.

name.description: Required — the name of the referenced File resource, even when optional is true.

optional.description: When true, admission succeeds even if the referenced File is absent.

MediaDefinition.description: A media slot referencing a File resource.

SelectedOptionDefinition.description: A single option choice (name + value) that identifies this variant within the parent product's option matrix. Both fields are required.

name.description: Required. Must exist on the parent product's spec.options.

value.description: Required. Must be one of the parent option's values.

QuantityDefinition.description: Inclusive quantity range that must be satisfied for a price template to apply.

max.description: Maximum order quantity (inclusive). Must be >= min when present.

StrategyDefinition.description: Pricing strategy applied when this price template is selected.

type.description: Required. One of the recognised pricing strategy types.

PriceRuleConstraint.description: A single eligibility constraint expressed as a CEL expression, validated for syntax at admission.

expression.description: Required. Must be a syntactically valid CEL expression.

EligibilityDefinition.description: Gate that controls when a price template is eligible.

PriceTemplate.description: A single price rule within a PriceSet.

name.description: Required within the enclosing prices list (identifier for this template).

validFromTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; must be before validUntilTime if both are set.

validUntilTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; must be after validFromTime if both are set.

currencyCode.description: Required. ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

amount.description: Required. Decimal amount as a string (e.g. "9.99"), to preserve precision.

priority.description: Evaluation priority. Lower values are evaluated first.

PriceSet.description: A named collection of price templates.

name.description: Required. Identifier for this price set, unique within the variant spec.

prices.description: Ordered list of price templates. Evaluation order is determined by priority.

PricingDefinition.description: Top-level pricing configuration for a ProductVariant.

InventoryDefinition.description: Inventory management configuration for a ProductVariant.

managed.description: Whether inventory levels are tracked. When false, the variant is always considered available.

policy.description: Behaviour when stock is exhausted. Only meaningful when managed is true. Empty string is the default.

ProductVariantSpec.description: Author-controlled declarative specification for a ProductVariant.

title.description: Required. Human-readable display title. Max 200 characters.

sku.description: Required. Stock-keeping unit; unique per namespace. Duplicate SKU admissions are skipped and leave the existing variant unchanged.

productRef.description: Required. Reference to the parent Product this variant belongs to (name is required; kind defaults to "Product" if omitted).

selectedOptions.description: The combination of option name/value pairs that uniquely identify this variant. Must match a valid combination on the parent Product.
